name: Frontend Design & Feedback Kit
description_md:
Give your coding agent a clear design reference and a repeatable way to check its work.

- Define spacing, colours, components and screen states

- Use a copyable design brief and feedback log

- Pair Figma references with browser checks and Playwright

Two-page PDF plus editable Markdown templates in a ZIP. Free download. Includes a worked example and prompts for your existing coding agent.
